environment.description: Same service binary deployed on EKS 1.28 behind an internal ALB. The ALB target group has a custom attribute `slow_start.duration_seconds=30`. An Envoy sidecar (Istio 1.19 mesh) is injected with a local rate limit filter configured via EnvoyFilter CR: the filter applies a token bucket with `max_tokens: 1, tokens_per_fill: 1, fill_interval: 30s` specifically on the path prefix `/api/v2/firmware/` with response code override 429. Additionally, the Istio PeerAuthentication policy enforces STRICT mTLS, meaning only mesh-internal services with valid SPIFFE identities can reach the pod. The pod's ServiceAccount has an AuthorizationPolicy that restricts source principals to `cluster.local/ns/device-gateway/sa/firmware-proxy` only. The Envoy filter descriptor key is `firmware_upload_limiter` and uses a per-connection token bucket (not shared), meaning each new TCP connection to the sidecar gets exactly 1 request per 30 seconds on the firmware path before receiving 429.
